name: ronron-vscode-remote
description: Shows the Claude Code sessions of a remote workspace (Remote Tunnels, SSH, containers) in Ronron's island on your computer, and lets Ronron's chat ask Claude Code in a workspace. Install it in the remote; install "Ronron for VS Code (local)" on your computer.

commands.title: Install the Claude Code hooks here

ronron.claudePath.description: Path of the Claude Code CLI in the remote, when it is not found by itself (PATH, ~/.local/bin, the Claude Code extension).
